column3: Close to the Greek; “having followed carefully” is rendered “having had perfect understanding.”
NKJV spells the name “Zacharias.” It has “His wife,” following the Textus Receptus wording; the critical text reads “a wife to him.”
NKJV includes “blessed are you among women,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “the Lord is with you.” “Greetings” is rendered “Rejoice.”
NKJV has “when she saw him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “she was greatly troubled at the saying.”
